newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Feb coffee exports 1.09 million bags -Febec.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Feb coffee exports 1.09 million bags -Febec.

text.p: Brazil exported 1.09 million 60-kg bags of coffee, ground and in beans, in February, below a January figure of 1.24 million bags, the Brazilian Federation of Coffee Exporters (Febec) said.
The February total is however nearly double the 593,801 bags exported in the same month in 1996.
Brazilian exports so far this year have reached 2.33 million bags, virtually twice the 1.18 million bags shipped in the first two months of 1996.
Revenue has also doubled to $324.01 million from $161.39 million earned in January/February 1996. Revenue last month was $165 million against $86.19 million in February last year.
The average price per bag rose 19 percent to $152.07 in February compared with $127.92 in January, Febec said.
Of February's total, 1.06 million bags were arabica coffee, while shipments of conillon reached 26,000 bags.
((-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
